purpose: Implement the uncertainty-aware catalogue stage of Sugar et al. (2017) on SonotaCo while preserving the already frozen episode and HDBSCAN results.

reference.title: Meteor shower detection with density-based clustering

classification: published-rule uncertainty-aware survey transfer with explicitly predeclared SonotaCo uncertainty and deterministic merger realizations
independent_corpus: SonotaCo 2023 one-shot only after the 2025 result, epsilon, source, seed rule, and merger realization are frozen

published_rules.feature_vector: six-component Sun-centered GEO vector: cos(sol), sin(sol), sin(lambda_g-sol)cos(beta_g), cos(lambda_g-sol)cos(beta_g), sin(beta_g), Vg/72
published_rules.epsilon_rule: 23rd percentile of each quality-filtered nominal event's fourth non-self nearest-neighbor distance
published_rules.cluster_overlap_merge_rule: merge cluster occurrences when at least 50 percent of either occurrence's members are shared

sonotaco_uncertainty_realization.radiant_sampling: independent Gaussian perturbations in observed equatorial RA and Dec using SonotaCo ra sd(deg) and de sd(deg), followed by deterministic conversion to Sun-centered ecliptic radiant
sonotaco_uncertainty_realization.velocity_sampling: Gaussian perturbation of Vg using SonotaCo vg sd(km/s)
sonotaco_uncertainty_realization.physical_bounds: reflect Dec into [-90,90], wrap RA to [0,360), and resample nonpositive or above-75-km/s cloned speeds from the same event distribution up to eight attempts before clipping to machine-safe bounds
sonotaco_uncertainty_realization.correlation_limit: SonotaCo does not publish event-level RA-Dec-velocity covariance; independence is an explicit survey-transfer approximation

deterministic_merger_realization.within_run_cluster_order: descending member count, then smallest event index
deterministic_merger_realization.master_matching_set: events present in at least half of a master's detected runs; fall back to the union if empty
deterministic_merger_realization.match_condition: intersection is at least half the smaller of occurrence and matching-set sizes
deterministic_merger_realization.multiple_master_match: merge every matching master into the smallest master identifier before adding the occurrence
deterministic_merger_realization.same_run_collision: union occurrence members and count the run once
deterministic_merger_realization.master_recurrence: number of distinct clone runs represented
deterministic_merger_realization.event_membership_probability: number of detected master runs containing the event divided by master recurrence

evaluation.primary_hard_assignment: assign each event to the retained master with highest membership probability if that probability is at least 0.5; ties use recurrence then smallest master id; otherwise noise
evaluation.secondary_binary_assignment: also report paper-style any-occurrence membership without using it to select parameters
metrics: noise fraction under primary hard assignment
evaluation.reference_labels: native SonotaCo shower labels, with spo and nonalphabetic/background tokens mapped to SPORADIC

prohibitions: Do not alter OrbitTrace, HDBSCAN, deterministic Sugar-core, D_SH, episode, calibration, or targeted-recovery results.
Do not call this an exact reproduction of ASGARD's ecliptic covariance model.
Do not reduce the 1000 clone catalogues after seeing runtime or results.
Do not change epsilon percentile, minimum samples, overlap fraction, recurrence thresholds, seed rule, or assignment threshold after data access.
Do not claim episode-scale superiority from this catalogue track.
